company_overview.title: Globex Technologies - Company Overview
company_overview.content: Globex Technologies Inc. is a San Francisco-based technology company founded in 2010, specializing in industrial IoT solutions and smart manufacturing platforms. The company has 1,200 employees and reported revenue of $380 million in 2025. Headquarters at 500 Innovation Drive, San Francisco, CA. Globex provides sensor networks and predictive maintenance software to manufacturers worldwide.

key_personnel.title: Maria Gonzalez - CEO at Globex Technologies
key_personnel.content: Maria Gonzalez has been CEO of Globex Technologies since its founding in 2010. Former engineering director at Siemens Digital Industries. Named one of Fortune's 40 Under 40 in 2019. MS in Computer Science from Stanford.

key_personnel.title: Robert Kim - VP Engineering at Globex Technologies
key_personnel.content: Robert Kim is VP of Engineering at Globex Technologies. Previously led IoT platform development at Amazon Web Services. Holds 12 patents in sensor technology and edge computing.

financials.title: Globex Technologies Series D Funding
financials.content: Globex Technologies raised $120 million in Series D funding led by Sequoia Capital in 2024, at a $2.1 billion valuation. The company reported revenue of $380 million in 2025, up 35% year-over-year. The company is not yet profitable, with a net loss of $28 million, but expects to reach profitability by Q3 2026. Burn rate is approximately $8 million per month.

esg.title: Globex Technologies ESG Initiatives
esg.content: Globex Technologies maintains a carbon-neutral office operation and uses 100% renewable energy for its data centers. The company has strong diversity metrics with 42% female leadership. Governance is rated highly with an independent board majority. MSCI ESG rating: A.

legal_compliance.title: Globex Technologies - Clean Compliance Record
legal_compliance.content: Globex Technologies maintains a clean regulatory record with no significant legal actions, sanctions, or compliance issues. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and complies with GDPR for its European operations. A minor patent dispute with CompetitorX was settled in 2024 for undisclosed terms.

supply_chain_risks.title: Globex Technologies Supply Chain Profile
supply_chain_risks.content: Globex Technologies sources semiconductors primarily from TSMC and Samsung, with secondary suppliers for non-critical components. Key customers include Acme Corp, Siemens, and Bosch. The company is heavily dependent on TSMC for its custom sensor chips, representing a single-point-of-failure risk. Globex supplies its SmartFactory platform to Acme Corp's Chicago and Texas facilities.

certifications.title: Globex Technologies Certifications
certifications.content: Globex Technologies holds ISO 27001 (Information Security), SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 9001:2015 certifications. The company is also FedRAMP authorized for government contracts.
